findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, get_project, get_writing, get_activity, get_open_source, search_portfolio · Private data: get_profile, list_projects, get_achievements, get_writing, get_resume · Public sink: get_profile, get_project, get_writing, get_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, get_project, get_writing, get_activity, get_open_source, search_portfolio · Private data: get_profile, list_projects, get_achievements, get_writing, get_resume · Public sink: get_profile, get_project, get_writing, get_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_portfolio" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
